_about: Public-domain Edward Stillingfleet (1635-1699, Bishop of Worcester, apologist and controversialist) for the Word Hoard: Origines Sacrae (2 vols, Oxford 1836), the Irenicum (Philadelphia 1842, from the second edition), A Rational Account of the Grounds of Protestant Religion (2 vols, Oxford 1844), Origines Britannicae (2 vols, Oxford 1842, with additional notes by Thomas Pantin) and The Doctrines and Practices of the Church of Rome Truly Represented (Edinburgh 1837, introduced and annotated by William Cunningham), raw Internet Archive OCR. Added 2026-10-03 by lane A, round 13 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
